request: Independent post-probe review of the retained native response, TP2 GPU marker trace, frozen analyzer result and candidate runtime parity

targets.reviewer_model: Sol; independent from implementer and evaluated model

tools_used.name: workflow_packet_validate
tools_used.error: Tool unavailable in reviewer session; packet shape checked against the anvil-serving-workbench contract.

artifacts.summary: The native response was correct and contained one reasoning close at completion index 64. Both TP ranks directly observed that accepted close as an actual budget-kernel store of token 154842 with END logit 1e9. Both workers nevertheless committed 76 tokens while the API returned 75: the API sequence is an exact prefix and the worker-only suffix is token 1654 after EOS token 154827. The frozen analyzer correctly returned unknown. The prior repeated-close behavior was not reproduced, so attribution of a second close remains unknown and no end-to-end resolution is established.

artifacts.title: Frozen full-sequence provenance gate failed
artifacts.concrete_state: Each rank reports request_end generated=76, but the native API response contains 75 completion token IDs.
artifacts.wrong_result_avoided: Attributing the complete native response or any second closing marker from a non-identical worker sequence.
artifacts.result: The frozen analyzer returned unknown; the gate was not relaxed and no retry was authorized.

artifacts.title: Original repeated-close behavior was not reproduced
artifacts.concrete_state: The API response has exactly one token 154842 and no duplicate answer; it stops on token 154827.
artifacts.wrong_result_avoided: Claiming that the earlier repeated-close defect is resolved from a single nonreproducing diagnostic request.
artifacts.result: Answer oracle passed, but second-close attribution was not exercised by this sample.

artifacts.interpretation: The first and only close in this run was observed after the actual budget-kernel store. This is observed correlation, not counterfactual proof that sampling could not otherwise select the token.

artifacts.limitation: Do not claim exact process-row parity because the before process inventory was incomplete.

artifacts.hypothesis: The worker-only post-EOS token is consistent with one async-scheduled batch already being in flight when the scheduler recognized the stop token and trimmed API-visible output.
artifacts.limits: No retained scheduler queue or configuration trace proves this path for this request.

artifacts.result: This review does not claim restored readiness, router convergence, functional smoke success or transaction closure.

advisory_priors.finding: The first and only accepted close was budget-forced in this run.
A second close was not reproduced, so the original repeated-close provenance question remains unanswered.
Exact end-to-end worker/API token identity failed because of one post-EOS worker token.
One correct answer cannot establish general model quality, parser correctness or resolution of the earlier failure.

operator_conclusion: Preserve the narrow observation that the accepted close at the 64-token boundary was budget-forced on both ranks, but retain full-sequence and second-close provenance as unknown. Ignis remains held; final campaign closure additionally requires independent restoration receipts.
